notes.title: NEW RELEASE - HEX PICROSS
notes.notes:
Hi Players, 

Today we released a new game on Steam called Hex Picross

This game is a picross on a hexagonal grid with a beautiful minimol design and a relaxing sound enviroment.

More info and trailer on steam page store:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113370/Hex_Picross/

notes.title: Save Game and Minimize Screen Option
notes.notes:
New Update

After the requests of the community, us add this resources:

- Save Game system

A save game system was add on all levels. Now you can stop and continue play the game when you want

- Minimize Screen Option

Now you can play on minimized screen if you want

New resources will be add coming soon. Send your suggestion on the comunity.

notes.title: Achivements Bug Resolved
notes.notes:
The achievement bug has been resolved.

If you did't earn the achievement by winning a game, follow the instructions in the start message.
